findings.title: Feature flags are a hardcoded static map with no managed service, change log, or targeting
evidence: apps/api/src/lib/feature-flags.ts:1-6 DEFAULT_FLAGS is a code literal
apps/api/src/lib/feature-flags.ts:8-15 resolves only FEATURE_<NAME> env overrides; flags are global (no per-tenant or per-user targeting)
findings.impact: Flag changes require a deploy, there is no audit trail of who changed a flag or when, and no staged/percentage rollout — limiting safe evolution and incident rollback.
findings.recommendation: Move flags to a managed store or a versioned config with an audit log, and support tenant/percentage targeting with a kill switch.
